GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok trapped Wide early So worked around to lead 1200 metres. led 4 lengths mid race. led turn. battled away # worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and raced very greenly in the early stages. When questioned, rider stated that when the tempo of the race slackened, he elected to allow his mount to improve forward to avoid being caught wide. He added that once he obtained the lead, it settled well and finished off the race satisfactorily.
